movie.title: Soumsoum, the Night of the Stars
movie.overview: Seventeen-year-old Kellou has been gifted with supernatural powers she does not understand. Her disquiet and uncertainty only change when she meets Aya. It is an encounter with destiny that forges a mystical world where the visible and invisible converge.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When seventeen-year-old Kellou discovers she possesses mysterious supernatural powers, her turbulent world changes forever after a fateful meeting with Aya leads her into a realm where the visible and invisible converge.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Seventeen-year-old Kellou struggles to navigate life while burdened by supernatural abilities she cannot comprehend. Disoriented and overwhelmed by her gifted nature, her isolation ends when she crosses paths with Aya. This chance encounter acts as a powerful catalyst, forging a mystical connection that reshapes both of their lives. Together, they embark on a destiny-defining journey where the boundaries of the physical and spiritual worlds blur.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Kellou is an ordinary seventeen-year-old girl thrust into extraordinary circumstances after discovering she possesses supernatural powers. Incapable of understanding the origins or nature of her newfound gifts, she experiences profound anxiety, disquiet, and isolation. Her life feels untethered as she tries to hide her abilities from the world around her, fearful of what they might mean. Everything changes dramatically when she meets Aya, whose presence brings a sense of clarity and purpose to Kellou's chaotic inner world. Their meeting is far from accidental; it is a profound encounter with destiny that unlocks deep-seated spiritual connections. As their bond deepens, the two unlock a hidden, mystical reality existing alongside daily life. In this strange environment, the visible physical world and the invisible metaphysical forces converge in unexpected ways. Kellou must learn to embrace her identity and harness her supernatural strengths alongside Aya. Ultimately, their shared path challenges them to navigate the dangerous, awe-inspiring intersection of the known and the unknown.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Soumsoum, the Night of the Stars is a poignant dramatic story that follows Kellou, a troubled seventeen-year-old coming to terms with mysterious, otherworldly powers. Overwhelmed by confusion and fear, Kellou struggles to make sense of her gifted nature until an unexpected meeting with Aya alters the course of her life. Recognizing their profound connection as an act of destiny, the two form an indelible bond that bridges the physical world with a hidden, mystical realm. The story explores themes of identity, destiny, and the unseen forces shaping human existence.

story_structure.climax: The converging forces of the seen and unseen realms culminate during the titular 'Night of the Stars', where Kellou must make a defining choice to fully embrace her power and fate.
story_structure.conflict: A pivotal encounter with Aya challenges Kellou's perception of reality, forcing her to confront her strange abilities and accept her connection to a hidden destiny.
story_structure.resolution: Kellou finds clarity and purpose in her identity, forever altering her path and forging a harmonious balance between the physical and mystical worlds alongside Aya.
story_structure.introduction: Seventeen-year-old Kellou struggles with mysterious, unexplainable supernatural powers that leave her feeling isolated and uncertain about her place in the world.
story_structure.risingAction: As the boundary between the visible and invisible worlds begins to blur, Kellou and Aya navigate mystical forces, learning to trust each other while unravelling the secrets behind Kellou's gifts.
